items.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
items.summary: Zelensky says Kyiv would support such a truce. Moscow has yet to comment.

confirmed_facts.text: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent - Published Donald Trump has claimed that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an "energy ceasefire", with Kyiv saying it would support such a move but Moscow yet to comment.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent - Published Donald Trump has claimed that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an "energy ceasefire", with Kyiv saying it would support such a move but Moscow yet to comment.

confirmed_facts.text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky initially expressed surprise at the announcement, before saying Kyiv would support it if Moscow did.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky initially expressed surprise at the announcement, before saying Kyiv would support it if Moscow did.

confirmed_facts.text: He also accused Russia of striking Ukrainian energy facilities after Trump's post.

confirmed_facts.text: Trump has been urging Ukraine to stop strikes on Russian oil infrastructure - which Kyiv says are vital to curtailing revenue for Moscow's war machine - so Russia can fulfil a recently-struck deal to release diesel to the US and the global market.

items.title: Cyberleek threatens full GTA 6 build leak unless Take-Two apologizes and his $30 million crypto memecoin goal is met
items.summary: Notorious GTA VI leaker Cyberleek is threatening to release a full build of GTA VI if Take-Two doesn't release a physical build, but only if its memecoin hits $30 million.

confirmed_facts.text: Cyberleek threatens full GTA 6 build leak unless Take-Two apologizes and his $30 million crypto memecoin goal is met — leaker demands physical release while pumping Solana memecoin to $30M The leak group's ultimatum is a bare-faced attempt to push the value of its associated meme
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Cyberleek threatens full GTA 6 build leak unless Take-Two apologizes and his $30 million crypto memecoin goal is met — leaker demands physical release while pumping Solana memecoin to $30M The leak group's ultimatum is a bare-faced attempt to push the value of its associated meme

confirmed_facts.text: Cyberleek, the infamous group that's been drip-feeding the gaming community with improperly tone-mapped leaks of GTA 6 from what appears to be a real final build of the game, has just put down an ultimatum for Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games: do a physical release for GTA

items.title: Russia's Yandex bot traffic nearly eliminated overnight after Ukraine drone strikes cripple multiple of 'Russia's Google' data centers
items.summary: Russian bot traffic falls dramatically as Ukraine takes out several Yandex data centers.

confirmed_facts.text: Cloudflare reports that bot traffic from the Yandex network has dropped to just 0.4% of the maximum number of HTTP requests recorded in the past two weeks.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Cloudflare reports that bot traffic from the Yandex network has dropped to just 0.4% of the maximum number of HTTP requests recorded in the past two weeks.

confirmed_facts.text: It initially dropped to around 57% on Oct.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It initially dropped to around 57% on Oct.

confirmed_facts.text: Global internet monitoring firm NetBlocks said that Yandex’s network traffic has dropped to just 30% for Yandex Cloud and 63% for Yandex LLC, most likely resulting in slower internet services or complete disruption for the average Russian.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Global internet monitoring firm NetBlocks said that Yandex’s network traffic has dropped to just 30% for Yandex Cloud and 63% for Yandex LLC, most likely resulting in slower internet services or complete disruption for the average Russian.

confirmed_facts.text: Unfortunately, the ordinary Russian wouldn’t be able to use high-speed satellite internet as a backup, as Starlink does not work in Russia, while the competing Rassvet constellation has had a good number of its existing satellites fall back to the surface after launch.

items.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
items.summary: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.
items.why_relevant: 胡塞袭击利雅得，地缘升级

confirmed_facts.text: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days - Published One person has been killed and 11 injured in a second strike on the international airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh, officials have said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days - Published One person has been killed and 11 injured in a second strike on the international airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh, officials have said.

confirmed_facts.text: A Saudi military spokesman said a projectile had hit King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, causing a fire in one of its passenger halls.
